applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Registration with the PDPO, consent, data subject rights
enforcement_authority: Personal Data Protection Office (PDPO) within NITA-U
penalties_range: Up to 245 currency points or 2% of annual gross turnover (corporations); up to 10 years' imprisonment
notes: Gazetted 3 May 2019 (some sources give that as commencement); Regulations 2021
